# ui::testing::PerfCounters

Header: `winui/testing/PerfCounters.hpp`.

How much work the library has done so far in this process, counted as it works: layout passes, measures, text layouts created, ticks and so on. Every count only grows, so a test compares two snapshots, most easily through [PerfCountScope](perf-count-scope.md). Counts don't flake the way times do, so a test can check that hovering a button measures nothing, and fail when it does.

Example: 
```cpp
ui::testing::HeadlessUI ui = ui::testing::create_headless();
ui.window().set_content(ui.button("Save"));
ui.layout({800, 600});
const ui::testing::PerfCountScope scope;
ui.layout({800, 600}); // nothing changed
REQUIRE(scope.elapsed().measures == 0);
```

| Field | Type | Default | |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `layout_passes` | `std::uint64_t` | `0` | [Window::layout()](../tree/window.md#layout) calls that measured and arranged the tree. |
| `focus_order_builds` | `std::uint64_t` | `0` | Times a window rebuilt its tab ring. |
| `visual_tree_builds` | `std::uint64_t` | `0` | Times a window rebuilt its [VisualTree](../tree/visual-tree.md) snapshot. |
| `measures` | `std::uint64_t` | `0` | [Element::measure()](../tree/element.md#measure) calls that reached measure_override(). |
| `arranges` | `std::uint64_t` | `0` | [Element::arrange()](../tree/element.md#arrange) calls that reached arrange_override(). |
| `renders` | `std::uint64_t` | `0` | [Element::render()](../tree/element.md#render) calls that reached render_override(). |
| `text_measurements` | `std::uint64_t` | `0` | Calls into a [TextMeasurer](../rendering/text-measurer.md), the headless one or the renderer's. |
| `text_formats_created` | `std::uint64_t` | `0` | [Text](../controls/text.md#uitext) formats the renderer created. |
| `text_layouts_created` | `std::uint64_t` | `0` | [Text](../controls/text.md#uitext) layouts the renderer created. |
| `brushes_created` | `std::uint64_t` | `0` | Brushes the renderer created. |
| `geometries_created` | `std::uint64_t` | `0` | Geometries the renderer created. |
| `stroke_styles_created` | `std::uint64_t` | `0` | Stroke styles the renderer created. |
| `bitmaps_created` | `std::uint64_t` | `0` | Bitmaps the renderer created. |
| `frames` | `std::uint64_t` | `0` | [Window::render()](../tree/window.md#render) calls. |
| `ticks` | `std::uint64_t` | `0` | [Window::tick()](../tree/window.md#tick) calls. |
| `element_ticks` | `std::uint64_t` | `0` | [Element::tick()](../tree/element.md#tick) calls, one per element ticked. |
| `timer_wakeups` | `std::uint64_t` | `0` | Times a window host woke up for a timer. |
